reason: My PSA reporting and finance person already flag the agreements that lose money, and I go through it all at the QBRs. I might take the free audit out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay £500 a month for something I think we mostly cover already.
objection: I'm not convinced it would find much that my own PSA reports and my finance person don't already catch, and I'm wary of sending our full client export and contracts to a third party for that.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit found a real recurring number, well beyond the subscription cost, that our own reporting had missed and that the clients actually accepted at renewal.
